chunks: Muhammad ibn Musa al-Mutawakkil narrated, saying: Ali ibn al-Husayn al-Sa'dabadi narrated to us, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah, from his father, from Ibn Sinan, from Abd al-Malik ibn Abdillah al-Qummi, who said:

Al-Kahili asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) - while I was with him - 'Did Ali (peace be upon him) seek refuge from the perishing of widows?' He said: 'Yes, but not in the way you think. He was only seeking refuge from diseases. The common people say
but it is not as they say.

key_terms.بَوَارِ الْأَيْمِ: The perishing or death of widows

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali seek refuge from according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from *Mani al-Akhbar* highlights the scholarly practice of *tafsir al-Qur'an* through linguistic precision, where Imam al-Sadiq (AS) corrects the popular misconception that 'bawar al-aym' referred to the death of widows, identifying it instead as a reference to specific physical ailments or diseases. This distinction underscores the Shia emphasis on understanding prophetic and imamic supplications through their precise lexical roots rather than colloquial usage, ensuring theological accuracy in devotional practices.

en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by Muhammed bin Musa bin Mutawakkil, that he said: We were told by Ali bin Hussain Sa’d-Abadi, from Ahmad bin Abi Abdillah, from his father, from Ibn Sinan, from Abdul-Malik bin Abdullah al-Qommi, that he said:

Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, was asked by al-Kahili, while I was at his place: Did Ali, peace be upon him, seek refuge (in Allah) from the perishing of widows? He said: Yes, and it is not as you think. He was only seeking refuge from diseases.
and it is not as they say.
